_comment: Compatibility conditions of this release (E01). Maintained by hand: update it in the same commit that changes a contract, a model or the platform. Copied into every release manifest and checked on the box by box_manifest.py.

components.note: adapter, RAG service and both UI forms (SSR server and embed bundle) of one release carry the same calendar version.

contracts.vivesecbox_api: ViVeSec v2 (/api/v1/*), status keys ui_ready/fs_ready (legacy dash keys kept)
contracts.embed_ui: the embed bundle reaches the box only through the versioned /api/v1 contract; a newer UI must work against an older box of the same contract

models.note: The index is valid only with the embedding model it was built with; changing it requires a full reindex.
